title: Retain multiple discoveries for one canonical Reference
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a editor, I want deduplicated references with all discovery provenance, so that I can trace corroboration and monitor overlap.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Retain multiple discoveries for one canonical Reference
  Scenario: Discover the same source through several monitors
    Given two Monitors or sponsoring sections encounter the same canonical source item
    When intake resolves its identity
    Then one canonical Reference identity is retained within the authorized identity scope
    And distinct discoveries retain each Monitor, source URL, sponsor, observation time and revision evidence
    And one discovery does not overwrite another's provenance or curation
  Scenario: Identity is ambiguous
    Given two source URLs might describe the same item but equivalence is uncertain
    When intake compares them
    Then uncertainty is retained for review rather than silently merging unrelated material
```

“Discoveries” is tentative naming, not a committed model/table. Canonical identity scope across publication backends and permitted metadata sharing must be designed; no authorization bypass or global cross-tenant deduplication is implied.
